source_instruction: i am looking for stainless steel hair cutting scissors of 7 inch size.
query: Ugh, my cat knocked over my pothos plant this morning and got soil all over the living room rug, I spent almost an hour scrubbing it out before I remembered I was supposed to stop by the salon supply area today. My roommate made matcha lattes that were way too sweet right after that, and we ended up bickering for ten minutes about whether oat milk or almond milk pairs better with ceremonial grade matcha, she swears almond is nuttier but I think oat makes it creamier. I’ve heard stainless steel hair cutting shears that are 7 inches long work really well for home trims, and I noticed all the options in that size and material here are under $40.
